$comment: Cap presets for Claudia trading and media spend. SOL caps are per trade and per UTC day. Apply CLI caps with `claudia config set max-sol-per-trade <n>` and `claudia config set max-sol-per-day <n>`; put the mcpEnv block in your MCP client's server env; pass mediaLimits to createMedia({ limits }). The stricter of the CLI and MCP caps always wins. Fund the agent wallet with no more than walletFundingSol.

cautious.for: first week, any automated agent, demos

standard.for: the defaults; a person confirms each trade

active.for: an experienced person who still confirms every trade; the wallet holds only what they accept losing

never: caps above the agent wallet's intended balance
agentLoop auto + allowTrades without the person choosing it explicitly
an agent raising its own caps
